name: mushi-website
_comment_overrides: postcss/sharp are pinned to patched releases. brace-expansion is NOT overridden: v5 changed to a named `expand` export and eslint's minimatch@3 chain calls it as a function, which breaks linting. eslint-plugin-{import,react,jsx-a11y} all still require minimatch@^3 at their latest versions, so there is no upstream fix. That advisory is dev-only (DoS via attacker-controlled glob patterns, which this repo does not have) and never reaches the static output.
_comment_browserslist: Modern targets only, so SWC stops transpiling and polyfilling what every browser this site actually sees already has. Lighthouse flagged 13.5 KB of Array.prototype.at/flat/flatMap, Object.fromEntries/hasOwn and String trimStart/End shims in the framework chunk. Safari 15.4 is March 2022 and is the floor for all of them; nothing older than these can run the site's own CSS (@property, :has, colour-mix) either, so this is not a real narrowing of support.
